Message:
KVM: VMX: Update vmcs.GUEST_CR3 only when the guest CR3 is dirty

When vcpu->arch.cr3 is changed, it is marked dirty, so vmcs.GUEST_CR3
can be updated only when kvm_register_is_dirty(vcpu, VCPU_EXREG_CR3).
